missingEndpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all API keys in your workspace. Returns key metadata without actual key values.
missingEndpoints.recommendation: Add list() method to ApiKeys resource

missingEndpoints.description: Delete an API key permanently. Cannot delete the currently authenticated key.
missingEndpoints.recommendation: Add delete(keyId: string) method to ApiKeys resource

missingEndpoints.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts subscribed to a specific topic.
missingEndpoints.recommendation: Add listContacts(topicId: string, params?) method to Topics resource

missingEndpoints.description: Create a new version of an existing form. Creates a DRAFT version that can be published later.
missingEndpoints.recommendation: Add createVersion(formId: string, params?) method to Forms resource

inconsistencies.issue: SDK uses path with trailing slash '/v1/api-keys/' but OpenAPI spec defines '/v1/api-keys' without trailing slash
inconsistencies.impact: May cause 404 errors or routing issues depending on server configuration. The trailing slash inconsistency could lead to failed API requests.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Update the SDK to use '/v1/api-keys' without trailing slash, or regenerate schema.d.ts from OpenAPI spec after fixing the spec

inconsistencies.issue: SDK schema response type is missing the 'id' field that is required in OpenAPI spec
inconsistencies.expected: Response should include: { object: 'api_key', id: string, key: string }
inconsistencies.actual: Response only includes: { object: 'api_key', key: string }
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot retrieve the API key ID after creation, which is needed for deletion operations
inconsistencies.recommendation: Regenerate schema.d.ts from the OpenAPI spec to include the 'id' field in the response type

inconsistencies.issue: ApiKeys resource is missing the list() method to retrieve all API keys
inconsistencies.expected: SDK should provide a list() method for GET /v1/api-keys
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot list their existing API keys programmatically, limiting key management capabilities
inconsistencies.recommendation: Add list(params?) method to ApiKeys class that calls GET /v1/api-keys

inconsistencies.issue: ApiKeys resource is missing the delete() method to delete API keys
inconsistencies.expected: SDK should provide a delete(keyId) method for DELETE /v1/api-keys/{keyId}
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot revoke or delete API keys programmatically, which is critical for security (rotating compromised keys)
inconsistencies.recommendation: Add delete(keyId: string) method to ApiKeys class

inconsistencies.issue: Topics resource is missing the listContacts() method to retrieve contacts subscribed to a topic
inconsistencies.expected: SDK should provide a listContacts(topicId, params?) method for GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot retrieve the list of subscribers for a specific topic, limiting audience management
inconsistencies.recommendation: Add listContacts(topicId: string, params?) method to Topics class

inconsistencies.issue: Forms resource is missing the createVersion() method to create new form versions
inconsistencies.expected: SDK should provide a createVersion(formId, params?) method for POST /v1/forms/{formId}/versions
inconsistencies.actual: Only listVersions() is implemented for the versions endpoint
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot create new versions of forms programmatically, limiting form A/B testing and iteration workflows
inconsistencies.recommendation: Add createVersion(formId: string, params?) method to Forms class

typeDiscrepancies.recommendation: Regenerate schema.d.ts to include 'id' field in API key creation response
typeDiscrepancies.codeExample:
// schema.d.ts should include:
id: string; // API key identifier

schemaIssues.issue: Schema path '/v1/api-keys/' has trailing slash but OpenAPI spec defines '/v1/api-keys' without trailing slash
schemaIssues.recommendation: Either fix the OpenAPI spec to include trailing slash, or regenerate schema after ensuring spec uses '/v1/api-keys'

schemaIssues.issue: Missing paths for API key list and delete operations in schema.d.ts
schemaIssues.recommendation: Regenerate schema.d.ts from the current OpenAPI spec to include all API key operations

jsdocIssues.issue: JSDoc mentions session authentication requirement but SDK uses Bearer token authentication
jsdocIssues.currentDoc: **Required Scope:** This endpoint requires session authentication (not API key)
jsdocIssues.expectedDoc: This documentation may confuse users as the SDK is designed for API key authentication, but the OpenAPI spec indicates this endpoint requires session auth
jsdocIssues.recommendation: Clarify in the documentation that this endpoint may have different authentication requirements

recommendations.title: Regenerate schema.d.ts from OpenAPI spec
recommendations.description: The schema.d.ts file appears to be out of sync with the current OpenAPI specification. Missing API key list/delete operations and response type discrepancies.
recommendations.rationale: Schema synchronization is critical for type safety. Current schema is missing endpoints and has path inconsistencies.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Run 'pnpm run schema:generate' to regenerate from apps/web/public/openapi.v1.json

recommendations.title: Implement missing ApiKeys methods (list, delete)
recommendations.description: The ApiKeys resource only exposes create() but the API supports listing and deleting API keys. These are essential for key management and security rotation.
recommendations.rationale: API key management is critical for security. Users need to list keys to audit access and delete keys to revoke compromised credentials.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add list() and delete() methods similar to other resources

recommendations.title: Implement Topics.listContacts() method
recommendations.description: Add method to retrieve contacts subscribed to a specific topic, matching the OpenAPI endpoint GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts.
recommendations.rationale: Provides parity with Segments.listContacts() and enables users to see topic subscribers.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add listContacts(topicId, params?) method following the pattern in Segments resource

recommendations.title: Implement Forms.createVersion() method
recommendations.description: Add method to create new form versions, matching the OpenAPI endpoint POST /v1/forms/{formId}/versions.
recommendations.rationale: Enables form versioning and A/B testing workflows. listVersions() is already implemented but createVersion() is missing.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add createVersion(formId, params?) method using POST to /v1/forms/{formId}/versions

recommendations.title: Fix trailing slash inconsistency in API keys path
recommendations.description: The SDK/schema uses '/v1/api-keys/' with trailing slash but OpenAPI spec uses '/v1/api-keys'. This may cause routing issues.
recommendations.rationale: Path consistency prevents potential 404 errors and ensures reliable API communication.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: After regenerating schema, update api-keys.ts to use the correct path without trailing slash

recommendations.title: Add type aliases for common response types
recommendations.description: Consider exporting type aliases for common response types (Contact, Topic, Segment, Form, etc.) for better developer experience.
recommendations.rationale: Makes it easier for users to type their variables and function parameters without deep schema path access.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Export type aliases like: export type Contact = components['schemas']['Contact'];
